Technical addendum for the bundle — please include this as a separate one‑page note: 

Summary (short): EU-origin user requests hit the EU load balancer and are served from our EU inference pool in Frankfurt (primary). We keep a small onshore prefix/KV cache in the EU region for hot prompts. For cost and resiliancy, traffic may route to US west cluster only on explicit failover (operator policy) or capacity overflow. Metadata telemetry (performance metrics, error traces) is sampled and aggregated in our telemetry pipeline which transits through an observability vendor (TelemetryCo) for 24/7 alerts; raw traces are redacted and kept for 30 days (see tia_scoping_note.docx for retention carveouts).

On subprocessors: Nimbus Cloud (edge CDN) is a caching-only processor — it never sees full persistent session state; we set TTLs to minimize payload residency. Still, because the CDN processes encrypted request bodies in some rare routes (supporting edge-adapted features), legal may want their attestation.

UK/IDTA note: For customers with UK residency requirements we publish an IDTA + UK addendum flow; for Solstice (EU-only origin) SCCs + TIA should suffice unless they explicitly request UK-addendum coverage.

Technical owner: jonas_weber (privacy engineering) — happy to hop on a call with their security team.

Jonas
